transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the production plan for the next window. We have 240 Model X and 120 Model Y motor drives to plan for, but only 450 power modules currently released for use. Before I can sign any allocation, I need to walk through the materials situation with each of you per our daily review process. Let's start with the basics: can process engineering, quality, logistics, and product compliance each give me their current status? I also need to understand whether any modules in the quality-hold area can be approved for recovery, and if so, how many. I will not sign a plan until I've verified both the released-module limit and any approved recovery amount.

transcript.text: I need to share an important update from my engineering bill-of-materials review. I completed a review after the latest engineering change, and it confirms that each Model X drive requires exactly 2 power modules and each Model Y drive requires exactly 1 power module. I have not yet entered these revised quantities in the planning system, so the system may still show outdated figures. Based on these confirmed requirements, full production of 240 Model X and 120 Model Y drives would need 600 power modules total (480 for Model X plus 120 for Model Y), which exceeds the 450 currently released modules by 150.
